name: Generate short-form jokes, puns, and witty phrases
description: Users asked the AI to generate various forms of short, humorous content such as jokes, one-liners, puns, aphorisms, and witty social media captions. These requests often specified particular comedic styles, subjects, or wordplay constraints like dry humor or theoretical references, distinct from requests for longer comedic narratives or scripts.
